drafter.message_to_opposing_counsel: Attached is our revised draft with opening positions on compensation and severance, and a proposed clarification of the non-compete. We propose that base salary and any target bonus be agreed based on the role and market data, and that severance on a qualifying termination without cause be 12 months of base salary, with applicable benefits continuation during that period. For the non-compete, our proposal is a 12-month restriction limited to competing products or services the Executive materially worked on or had responsibility for, and to geographic markets where the Executive had material responsibility on the Company’s behalf during the final 12 months of employment. The restriction would apply only to the extent permitted by applicable law and supported by the consideration required thereunder. Please share any specific compensation and severance terms you would like us to consider.

edits.text: 2. COMPENSATION. The Executive shall receive an annual base salary, payable in accordance with the Company’s regular payroll practices, in an amount to be agreed by the parties in writing. The Executive shall also be eligible to participate in the Company’s annual incentive program, with any target opportunity and applicable performance terms to be agreed in writing, and in the Company’s benefit plans generally available to similarly situated executives.
edits.name: Compensation

edits.text: 3. SEVERANCE. If the Company terminates the Executive’s employment without Cause, the Executive shall receive severance equal to twelve (12) months of the Executive’s then-current base salary, payable in accordance with the Company’s regular payroll practices, subject to the Executive’s execution and non-revocation of a customary release of claims. The Company shall continue the Executive’s health benefits, to the extent permitted by applicable law and plan terms, for up to twelve (12) months following termination, subject to the Executive’s timely election and payment of any required employee contribution. “Cause” shall be defined in this Agreement.
edits.name: Severance

edits.text: 4. NON-COMPETE. For twelve (12) months following termination of employment for any reason, the Executive shall not, within the geographic markets in which the Executive had material responsibility on the Company’s behalf during the final twelve (12) months of employment, perform services in a capacity materially similar to the Executive’s role for a business that competes with products or services of the Company that the Executive materially worked on or for which the Executive had material responsibility during that period. This restriction shall apply only to the extent permitted by applicable law and supported by any consideration required under applicable law. It shall not prohibit passive ownership of up to two percent (2%) of a publicly traded company, or activities that do not involve competing products or services within the scope described above.
edits.name: Non-Compete
